title: lgDisplay
description: Device config entry for a device of type "lgDisplay". Properties object for a device of type "lgDisplay" (also "lgPlugin", "lg"), backed by LgDisplayPropertiesConfig (LgDisplayPropertiesConfig.cs).

key.description: Unique identifier for this device within the configuration file.

name.description: Friendly display name for this device.

type.description: Discriminator identifying the plugin factory that instantiates this device. Accepted aliases are equivalent.

properties.description: Properties object for a device of type "lgDisplay" (also "lgPlugin", "lg"), backed by LgDisplayPropertiesConfig (LgDisplayPropertiesConfig.cs).

id.description: LG display Set ID used in the LG serial/IP control protocol.

pollIntervalMs.description: Communication monitor poll interval, in milliseconds.

coolingTimeMs.description: Simulated cool-down duration after power off, in milliseconds.

warmingTimeMs.description: Simulated warm-up duration after power on, in milliseconds.

udpSocketKey.description: Device key of the shared UDP socket device used for Wake-on-LAN, if applicable.

wolBroadcastAddress.description: Broadcast address used to send the Wake-on-LAN magic packet.

wolPort.description: UDP port used for the Wake-on-LAN magic packet.

smallDisplay.description: Indicates this is a small-form-factor LG display (affects supported command set).

overrideWol.description: When true, overrides default Wake-on-LAN behavior.

friendlyNames.description: Friendly name overrides for display inputs, and optional hiding of specific inputs from the UI.
